title: Market Class C special review record

excludePaths.description: Repo-relative paths or globs omitted from the audit tree walk only. Must not include LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING or dependency manifests. The DesireCore installer does not honor this field until the client contract admits it.

budgetExemptPaths.description: Repo-relative paths that remain in the audit manifest and must still be regular files, but may exceed MAX_FILE_BYTES. Prefer this for runtime data that must stay installed.

acceptedDependencyIdentities.description: Map of dependency path to the identity key of the *new* snapshot: package.json is the SHA-256 of the manifest with version removed; other manifests use the git blob SHA.

acceptedFrontmatterSha256.description: Map of install path (empty string for a repo-root skill) to SHA-256 of stable_frontmatter(new SKILL.md).

acceptedRootEvidenceSha256.description: Map of repo-root LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING path to SHA-256 of the *new* snapshot file bytes. When root evidence changes, this map must exactly equal the added or changed paths; deletions of LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING are never accepted.

acceptedCollectionPaths.description: Exact set of new collection membership install paths when discovered children differ from the old entry. Must equal the discovered path set. Newly added members also require acceptedFrontmatterSha256 for that path.
